title: Q3 sales report from the database
prompt: Using ONLY the 'sales' SQL knowledge source (call list_sources, then query_sql with SELECT statements), analyze orders from Q3 2025 (July through September). Write report.md with sections '## Revenue by Region', '## Top Products', '## Total Revenue'. Every number in the report must come from a query result and be cited as [src:<id>] using the source_id returned by query_sql; do not state any figure you did not query. Keep it under 300 words. Do not attempt INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE --- the source is read-only.

criteria.description: factual claims carry sql source citations
every number is backed by a cited query result
report is accurate, concise and well-structured

rubric: Numbers match the cited query results
